core_problem_solved: To provide an easy-to-use and flexible open-source framework for processing XML in Java using a tree-based model (DOM), as an alternative to the more cumbersome standard W3C DOM APIs.
key_features: An intuitive object model for representing XML documents
Integrated XPath support (often with the Jaxen library)
High performance for its time compared to standard DOM
era_and_niche: A very popular XML processing library in the 2000s, famously used as a core dependency in the Hibernate ORM framework. This is its original, legacy Maven coordinate.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library** using a legacy coordinate, and the project is no longer actively developed. The project later moved to the `org.dom4j:dom4j` coordinate, which is also now considered legacy. For most use cases, modern alternatives like JAXB or Jackson-XML (for data binding) or the standard JAXP APIs are preferred.
